race.comment: PONTE ARCOBALENO (2) was beaten 4.75 lengths last starts, but that was by a horse who looks set to race through the grades. Drawn awkwardly but if he repeats that run he'll go close. BELMASAI (4) was expected to do more last start when out of the placings over 1100m at Berrigan, beaten 6 lengths. This looks a sterner test than last time but on his best form he is one of the chief contenders. ATTABOOM (6) returned from a spell last start with a strong win by a long neck over 1009m at Echuca. Open to plenty of improvement and is worth including. YAKI ISHI (5) was always well back last time out and never really threatened when ninth over 1200m at Donald. Among the leading chances on his best form. DANGEROUS SECRET (10) has a moderate winning strike-rate but performed well when returning from a break last time at Mt Gambier, finishing third and only a head from the winner at the end of 900m when she made late ground. Likely improver with strong prospects.
